title: Cursive Returned In 25 States As Reading Faded
hook: Schools are reviving a script many young adults cannot read.
closing: Without cursive literacy, original family records and historical documents become harder to understand.
question: Did you learn cursive?

segments.say: Cursive instruction is required in 25 states. Schools are rebuilding a reading skill that had disappeared from classrooms.
67 percent of young Americans cannot read cursive. Handwritten family records can look like code.
80 percent of National Archives holdings use cursive. Losing the skill can lock readers out of original history.
